angle: Instead of stating the binomial pmf up front, this video earns it from a 2-of-3 orange-versus-grape Fanta hand count (ordered versus any-order sequences) and then reuses the same counting to assemble a two-sided p-value of 1, binding distribution and test into one story.
angle_detail: Work [05:34]-[09:09] for the term-by-term formula anatomy (counts, then p-powers) checked against the hand count, then [11:25]-[14:13] for the four-of-seven case and the equally-rare-or-rarer sum. Samples never exceed seven and captions repeat heavily, so budget patience and look elsewhere for large-n behavior. Heed the independence caveat at [14:51]: one taster must not shift the next taster's probability.
